description: Reads one site's settings and state — serving mode, password, forms, scheduled takedown, folder, whether it is paused — and its versions, newest first, with the one being served marked. Also says which settings the account's plan does not include.

site.description: Subdomain or site id, from list_sites.

name: get_site

perMonth.description: Proxied requests the plan allows a month; 0 when it has none.

routes.description: Proxy routes in the live version's _redirects.

suspended.description: Whether the month is spent and calls answer 429.

switchedOff.description: Whether Drop2Run switched this site's proxy off.

upstreams.description: Origins its /api/* routes may call, as update_site's `upstream` sets them.

blocked.description: Whether Drop2Run blocked this origin for every site.

headers.description: Header names and each value's last four characters; never a value.

used.description: Proxied requests this month, every site of the account.

apiProxy.description: Its API proxy, or null where the proxy is not available.

available.description: Which settings the account's plan includes.

comments.description: Who may comment on its pages: nobody, the people invited to comment (only while it is invite-only), or anybody signed in. Null when that could not be read.

expiresAt.description: When it is scheduled to come down, or null.

expiryAction.description: What the takedown does: `pause` or `delete`, or null when none is scheduled.

folderId.description: The folder it is filed in, or null at the top level.

formerSubdomains.description: The subdomains it used to answer on, newest first; each redirects to it.

invitedOnly.description: Whether only invited people can open it, or null when that could not be read. Null does not mean public.

name.description: What it is called, or null.

passwordProtected.description: Whether visitors must type a password.

status.description: `active`, `paused`, or a state the platform put it in.

subdomainChangesLeft.description: How many more times change_subdomain may move it, or null when there is no limit.

deployId.description: Identifier of the version, which rollback_site takes.

filesKept.description: Whether its files are still stored; a version without them cannot be rolled back to.

live.description: Whether this is the version being served.

status.description: `live` for the one being served, `superseded` for one served before, `ready` for one that finished but was never served, `failed`, or a stage still under way. Whether it can be rolled back to is `filesKept`, not this.

title: Read a site's settings
